description: This file defines the 'Note' class which extends the 'File' class. It handles operations related to notes attached to CRM entities, including managing attachments, deletion, and data retrieval for display and export purposes within the SuiteCRM platform. It also includes methods for access control and related contact information.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Represents a note entity in SuiteCRM, extending the File class to include note-specific attributes and methods for managing attachments, related data, and access control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the Note class, calling parent constructor.

methods.name: safeAttachmentName
methods.description: Checks the filename extension against a list of 'bad' extensions and appends '.txt' if necessary, also setting MIME type accordingly.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to mark a note as deleted, with additional handling for email attachments if configured.

methods.name: deleteAttachment
methods.description: Deletes the attachment file associated with this note, ensuring file system cleanup and resetting related properties.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the note for summary display.

methods.name: getAttachmentContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the attachment file if it exists.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to export notes with optional ordering and filtering.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional list view fields, delegating to detailed fill methods.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates related contact fields and email addresses for display.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data array for list views, including attachment link and related contact info.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Provides access control logic for list view display permissions, considering ownership and security groups.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates which interfaces ('ACL' and 'FILE') the bean implements.
